usedFor: buttondown holds newsletter emails and subscribers, and Hastewire rewrites text when “email created” runs “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “email created” in buttondown, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A fresh email draft gets a pass that makes its wording sound natural.

watchOut: “email updated” fires on edits too, so one email can pass through “Humanize Text” more than once.
